implementation_summary: Correct previously missed genuine clipped PARTIAL D3D9 TARGET Clears after a real native D3D11 Draw: even without a whole-backbuffer Clear, earlier RAW source GPU PRE/POST pixels are no longer current. The real D3D9 Clear hook authenticates same source device, exact canonical RT identity, matching target extent and preview game owner before revoking captured tiles. Reuse of staging remains fenced by D3D11 GPU EVENT completion, post-Clear genuine game Draw may recapture. Foreign/offscreen/mismatched-target Clears never invalidate. Tests include positive partial-Clear / stale-pixel / fence-rearm and negative foreign/offscreen/extent cases. No native full-game frame or HMD pixel visibility claimed.
